description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model to use for this agent. If not specified, inherits from parent. Claude models: sonnet, opus, haiku. Codex aliases: sol, astra, luna, terra, codex (default, gpt-6-astra). Codex slugs: gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional Codex reasoning effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra (supported levels vary by model). When omitted, no effort override is passed and the Codex CLI config (~/.codex/config.toml) applies. Ignored by the Claude runner.

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this agent in the background. The tool result will include an output_file path - use Read tool or Bash tail to check on output.

max_turns.description: Maximum number of agentic turns (API round-trips) before stopping. Used internally for warmup.

resume.description: Optional agent ID to resume from. If provided, the agent will continue from the previous execution transcript.

$comment: Output schemas are documented in task_tool.output.schema.json
